title: 第25章 御兽峰弟子摊上大事了下第26章 购买丹药
slug: 让你修仙没让你祸害修仙界啊
content_zh:
“把宗门当成他们家了是吧，是谁给他们的胆子！”
三长老勃然大怒。
九长老急忙安慰道：“三姐，冤有头，债有主，我看这事和这两个小弟子无关，全是御兽峰的错，必须狠狠处理此事，不然今天敢在枫叶广场，明天就敢在你我洞府门口了。”
“没错！”
三长老取出一块具有传讯功能的令牌，在里面传入一道灵魂传音。
“我这就叫老六滚过来看看他教的好弟子！”
不一会儿，六长老风风火火的赶了过来。
“三姐，你找我有何事？”
“九妹你也.....”
还不等六长老打完招呼，三长老直接拧着六长老的耳朵，把他拉到枫叶广场边上。
“三姐，你这是干嘛，这边还有两个小辈呢，给我留点面子了。”
三长老气愤的指着枫叶广场质问道：“你告诉我，这是哪里？”
六长老看了一眼，脱口而出：“这不宗门化粪池吗，还别说，来宗门几百年了，我还是头一次见到呢！”
“三姐，这化粪池真有意思哈，还种上了不少树！”
“我化你个头啊，你信不信我把你丢进去化了！”
三长老指着旁边的大牌子，“你告诉我这是哪？”
六长老愣了一下，慢慢读出上面的字。
“枫叶广场？”
“还别说，这化粪池的名字还挺文雅，咱们玄天宗不愧是有着万年文化底蕴的大宗！”
三长老：“你......”

“噗~”
九长老直接笑场。
秦宇把前世今生所有伤心的事情都在脑海里过了一遍，这才狠狠压下上扬的嘴角。
一扭头，看到正要笑出声的李正通。
秦宇眼疾手快，捏住李正通的肚皮用力一拧，直到李正通五官扭曲，满脸狰狞，秦宇才松开了手。
九长老说道：“六哥，这里是一个广场，这些树都是枫树，秋天叶子变红，很好看的。”
“啊？叶子？哪有叶子啊？”
“叶不叶子不重要，重要的是地上这些污秽之物，正是你御兽峰外门弟子的杰作！”
“看看你御兽峰教导的弟子多有本事，把整个玄天宗当成露天厕所，把杂役弟子当作清洁员，杂役弟子们稍微抱怨几句就被一顿臭骂甚至殴打，真是比宗主都牛啊！”
“啊？”
六长老大为震惊。
“我们御兽峰第一项规定就是禁止灵兽随意大小便，那些外门弟子平时去内门上课表现的也很是乖巧啊！”
六长老看了一会儿，发现这些粪便是灵兽服用一种特殊丹药后排出的。
content_en:
"You think of the sect as their home, right? Who gave them the courage!"
The third elder was furious.
The Ninth Elder hurriedly comforted him: "Third sister, the grievance has its owner, and the debt has its owner. I think this matter has nothing to do with these two young disciples. It is all the fault of Yushou Peak. This matter must be dealt with severely. Otherwise, I dare to be in Maple Leaf Square today and at the door of your cave tomorrow."
"That's right!"
The third elder took out a token with a communication function and transmitted a soul message inside.
"I'm going to tell Lao Liu to come here and see the good disciples he teaches!"
After a while, the Sixth Elder rushed over in a hurry.
"Third sister, what do you want from me?"
"Jiu Mei, you too..."
Before the sixth elder could finish saying hello, the third elder directly twisted the sixth elder's ears and pulled him to the edge of Maple Leaf Square.
"Third sister, what are you doing? There are two juniors here, please save me some face."
The third elder angrily pointed at Maple Leaf Square and asked, "Tell me, where is this?"
The Sixth Elder took one look and blurted out: "Isn't this the sect's septic tank? Not to mention, this is the first time I've seen it after coming to the sect for hundreds of years!"
"Third sister, this septic tank is really interesting. It even has many trees planted!"
"I transformed you. Believe it or not, I threw you in and transformed you!"
The third elder pointed to the big sign next to him, "Tell me where this is?"
The Sixth Elder was stunned for a moment and slowly read the words above.
"Maple Leaf Plaza?"
"Not to mention, the name of this septic tank is quite elegant. Our Xuantian Sect is indeed a large sect with thousands of years of cultural heritage!"
Third Elder: "You..."
"Pfft~"
The ninth elder laughed directly.
Qin Yu went through all the sad things in his past and present lives in his mind, and then he suppressed the raised corners of his mouth.
Turning around, he saw Li Zhengtong who was about to laugh out loud.
Qin Yu, with quick eyes and quick hands, pinched Li Zhengtong's belly and squeezed it hard. Only when Li Zhengtong's facial features were distorted and his face looked ferocious did Qin Yu let go.
The Ninth Elder said: "Brother Six, this is a square. These trees are all maple trees. The leaves turn red in autumn, which is very beautiful."
"Ah? Leaves? Where are the leaves?"
"Ye Bu Ye is not important. What is important is that these filthy things on the ground are the masterpieces of your disciples from the outer sect of Beast Control Peak!"
"Look at how capable the disciples taught by you at Yushou Peak are. They treat the entire Xuantian Sect as an open-air toilet, and treat the handyman disciples as cleaners. The handyman disciples will be scolded or even beaten after complaining for a few minutes. They are really better than the sect leader!"
"Huh?"
The Sixth Elder was shocked.
"The first rule of our Beast Control Peak is that spirit beasts are prohibited from urinating and defecating at will. Those outer disciples who usually go to inner sect classes behave very well!"
The Sixth Elder looked at it for a while and found that these feces were excreted by spirit beasts after taking a special elixir.
